The pose Laura asked for

Her three notes, answered

  1. THE KNEE The thigh rises out of the hip into a rounded knee at chest height, the shin comes down to the foot flat on the floor, the calf sits on the back of the shin, and the knee bends the right way (the resin's angle). The hand's palm lies on top of the kneecap and the fingers fan over its far side, not against its side.
  2. THE CORE The torso is a leaning egg: chest up under the chin, the belly soft and cream on the front with three folds, the hips settled flat on the floor. The chest, hips and raised thigh are one silhouette drawn as one shape, so there is no seam and no lump where the thigh or the near arm joins; the far leg and the propping arm come out from behind her.
  3. THE HEAD The head sits square on the shoulders (the chin on the chest, no neck, no collar) and is tipped back a little, looking out. The face is pass 9's: open happy eyes, lashes on the outer top of each eye dome, blush, the open smile with the tongue, the small purple crown seated between the domes, behind them.
